column3: Welcome to the second annual conference of the Northshore Library Network. This year's theme is reading in a changing community.

Lunch is served in the Atrium from 12:30. Cloakroom on the ground floor, next to the lifts. Quiet room: Room 1.02, open all day. Step-free access from the Quay Street entrance. Please wear your badge at all times while in the building.
